takes.overview: Week 1 is banked (138.3-99.0 over Angie's) and you're still #1 in projected strength with 98% playoff odds. Forwards rank #1 rest of season and goalies #1; D is the soft spot - #1 in per-game quality but #4 rest of season - so that's where any buying should go. Hellebuyck (suspended, not on the Jets' roster per Oct 2 report) and Bedard (IR) stay flagged, not discounted - check news; Bedard was on the ice Monday per Scott Powers of The Athletic.
takes.matchup: Week 2 vs Mike's Magnificent Team is a coin flip: projected 135.9-135.0 (51%), starts 65 vs 66. Tonight is the hole - 4 starts to their 8 - but you win it back Tuesday (11 vs 8) and Friday (9 vs 7). With volume this even, a Hartman add for Zacha (+5 over the next two weeks) is a small but real edge in a 51% week.
takes.roster: Celebrini, Bouchard, Seider and Guenther (11.8 pts already) are the core. You're carrying four goalies now - Blackwood (11.4 pts, 1 GA on 26 shots Saturday) tops the drop ranking by model cost, with Zacha, Martone and McKenna next. Your call: if Hellebuyck's suspension drags on, Blackwood is useful cover; if you want a skater, Zacha is the cleanest skater cut.
takes.free_agents: Hartman (+31 ROS, 7 playoff-week games) is the best add, then Mintyukov (+26), the D help your #4 rest-of-season blue line needs, and Strome (+24). Opportunity watch: Jake Sanderson will miss at least two games (per Jackson Starr of the Senators' site), which bumps Artem Zub only short-term (+1.8 over two weeks) - not worth a roster spot.
takes.trades: You have a goalie surplus and a D need - trade Swayman for D. Swayman to McDavid Mania for Adam Fox (you +41.7, them +26.0) is the cleanest win-win; Swayman for Sanderson scores higher (+46.5) but he's now out at least two games, so check news first. Tuch to PuttinOnTheFoil for Hagel + Slafkovsky (+45.9) is the forward-side option if you'd rather keep all the goalies.
takes.playoffs: Your playoff weeks (Mar 22-Apr 4) project 319.0, 1st by 25 points over Torts Illustrated. The issue is light days - 91 open skater-slot-days vs just 4 wasted games - so late pickups should play on your open days. Strome (WSH, 8 playoff-week games, 7 on open days) leads the free-agent targets; Leo Carlsson (Torts) tops the trade list.
